dialogues.speaker: Urusov
dialogues.text: What do you mean Prime Ice handicrafts can't be checked?

dialogues.speaker: Kholodnaya
dialogues.text: Er... exactly what it sounds like. Once Prime Ice crafts leave town, they always disappear before long. That's just how it is.

dialogues.speaker: Kholodnaya
dialogues.text: How is it that you didn't know something so basic? Seeing how you've also checked so many rare volumes from Torchlight Books, I'd thought you were the knowledgeable type.

dialogues.speaker: Urusov
dialogues.text: What? Is that how you usually talk to passengers?

dialogues.speaker: Kholodnaya
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. Please don't file a complaint. If you do, they really will fire me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Urusov
dialogues.text: Fine... I get you. I just lost my job too. It's why I'm heading to Nasha Town. But that still doesn't solve my problem. Tell me, what am I supposed to do now?

dialogues.speaker: Kholodnaya
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but there's really nothing I can do. Maybe you could try returning them to wherever you purchased them from?

dialogues.speaker: Urusov
dialogues.text: That probably wouldn't work. Some of the things I have here, I've already tried to return them before. But they just wouldn't take them back...

dialogues.speaker: Urusov
dialogues.text: That Snegurochka who's supposedly from the House of Hesperides — or so she kept saying — said my gifts weren't good enough for her! She didn't even open them before sending them back, and somehow the shop still wouldn't allow me to return them. Can you believe that?
